reading: A calendar header with a "November 2026" title, Prev/Today/Next outline nav buttons, and a green "+ New event" button, above a 5-week month grid (Mon–Sun) filled with day numbers and colour-coded event chips as described, with day 11 highlighted.

actions.instruction: Text placeholder (wavy squiggle) at top-left reads as a page heading; render as literal text "November 2026" as the calendar's month/year title.
A row of outline (ghost-style) navigation buttons next to the title: "‹ Prev", "Today", "Next ›", used to move between months.
A solid green button with white text labeled "+ New event", placed at the top-right for creating a new calendar event.
Large bordered rectangle becomes a month calendar grid, columns Mon through Sun, 5 rows of day cells. First row starts with trailing days of the previous month
